title: App reviews to a useful feedback shortlist
description: Read limited public Google Play and App Store review windows. Choose a demo or enter app IDs, then filter ratings/keywords. CSV and Markdown feedback report use only saved matching reviews. No login or LLM key. Source access and response formats can change.

appPreset.title: Demo app (optional)
appPreset.description: ChatGPT selects its Android and iOS app IDs as a demo, not a customer or endorsement. Custom app IDs are added before the preset. Choose Custom only to use your own apps.

googlePlayApps.title: Google Play apps
googlePlayApps.description: Android package IDs such as com.openai.chatgpt or HTTPS play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=... URLs. Up to 10 apps across both stores and the selected demo.

appStoreApps.title: Apple App Store apps
appStoreApps.description: Numeric Apple IDs such as 6448311069 or HTTPS apps.apple.com/.../id... URLs. Reads a limited public feed; no promise of full review history.

country.title: Requested storefront country
country.description: Two-letter store code, e.g. us, gb or vn. This is request context, not the reviewer's country of residence. Results may vary by storefront.

language.title: Google Play language hint
language.description: Language code such as en or vi. Google Play request hint only; no guaranteed language filtering. Does not change Apple's public storefront feed.

maxReviews.title: Maximum saved matching reviews
maxReviews.description: Global cap after filters and known-ID skips; also bounded by the run spending limit. Source data can yield fewer or zero matching reviews.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum saved reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Per app/store cap after filtering. Apps are processed in input order; a low global cap can skip later apps.

maxPagesPerApp.title: Maximum source pages per app
maxPagesPerApp.description: Bounds scans even if filters reject most reviews. Public feeds are partial; max 10 pages is not a guarantee of 500/1000 reviews or complete history.

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Inclusive 1-5 star filter applied before saving and charging.

maxRating.title: Maximum star rating
maxRating.description: Inclusive 1-5 star filter. Choose 3 for a low-rating shortlist; a rating does not prove a particular problem or sentiment.

appVersionKeywords.title: App version contains any value
appVersionKeywords.description: Optional case-insensitive substring OR matching against the version exposed by each review. Unknown versions are excluded when set; no release date is inferred. Up to 30 values.

replyFilter.title: Visible developer reply
replyFilter.description: Google Play can expose replies. Apple RSS reply status is unavailable, so Apple reviews are excluded by either reply-specific filter. Not shown means no reply in this public feed, not proof of no reply elsewhere.

includeKeywords.title: Review contains any keyword
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive substring OR matching across review title and text. Empty means unrestricted. Up to 30 terms; combined with other filters using AND.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude review containing any keyword
excludeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive substring OR exclusions. Up to 30 terms. Applied before saving/charging.

topicFilters.title: Require any keyword topic (optional)
topicFilters.description: Allowed labels: stability, performance, billing, login, ads, privacy, feature-request. Matches literal English/Vietnamese terms, not AI intent. Praise and negations can match. Empty means any topic; see each row's evidence.

featureRequestsOnly.title: Require an explicit feature-request phrase
featureRequestsOnly.description: Requires a configured phrase such as 'please add', 'I wish' or 'vui lòng thêm'. This is a keyword heuristic, not proof of demand or intended meaning. English/Vietnamese phrases only.

reviewedAfter.title: Reviewed on or after (optional)
reviewedAfter.description: Inclusive ISO date/timestamp. Reviews with unknown dates are excluded when set. Dates may reflect edits; this is not guaranteed original publication.

knownReviewIds.title: Previously saved review keys
knownReviewIds.description: Paste the KNOWN_REVIEW_IDS array from a previous run to skip those keys before saving/billing. Same-ID edited reviews are also skipped. Up to 10,000 keys; callers must transfer the returned state explicitly.

previousSnapshot.title: Previous review fingerprint snapshot
previousSnapshot.description: Paste SNAPSHOT from a prior run to identify NEW/UPDATED/UNCHANGED reviews. Must match country/language. Bounded to 10,000 review hashes and 2 MiB UTF-8; oldest saved entries are evicted with snapshotTruncated=true if needed. Only saved rows advance state; absent reviews are never marked deleted. Keep knownReviewIds empty to allow same-ID edits to be checked.

changedOnly.title: Save only reviews new to snapshot or updated
changedOnly.description: With previousSnapshot, skip unchanged reviews before saving and review-saved billing. NEW means absent from this supplied baseline, not newly posted. Text/rating/version/reply changes within exposed fields are detected; votes, dates and observation time alone are not edits. Schedules must explicitly pass SNAPSHOT to the next run.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Verified HTTPS requests with no redirect following. At most one retry for transient network/5xx errors; access denials and rate limits stop that source.

minDelaySeconds.title: Minimum pause per host (seconds)
minDelaySeconds.description: Sequential paced requests, bounded by 60 HTTP attempts and a 180-second source-processing deadline per run. No proxies or login bypass.
